about_the_game:
Step into the gunner’s seat of the AC-130, the guardian angel of the battlefield. In this tactical shooter, you will conduct reconnaissance, deliver devastating fire support, and protect allied forces during dangerous missions across diverse conflict zones.

  • Features:
    Precision Fire Support: Use 25mm, 40mm, and 105mm cannons to neutralize threats with pinpoint accuracy.
    Immersive Combat Atmosphere: Experience the tension of the battlefield with authentic night vision, thermal imaging, and radio chatter.
    Strategic Gameplay: Identify targets, prioritize threats, and adapt instantly to changing mission parameters.
    Dynamic Missions: From convoy protection to high-value target elimination, each operation offers unique tactical challenges.
    Rich Narrative Backdrop: Confront the enigmatic mastermind known as Zmey, whose shadow looms over a global conflict.

When the night sky ignites with fire, every shot counts — the mission, and countless lives, depend on you.
